name: Edit with instructions
description: Edit an image by describing the change in plain words (Qwen-Image-Edit): change the background, add or remove objects, restyle, fix text. Optional reference images.

references.description: Optional reference images (image 2, image 3 in the instruction)

model.description: An instruction-edit model (catalog models with engine qwenimage-edit, e.g. qwen-image-edit-2511).

instruction.description: The change to make, e.g. "replace the sky with a sunset".

steps.description: Denoising steps (default: the model's recipe, 4 for the Lightning build of qwen-image-edit-2511).

guidance.description: True CFG scale (default: the model's recipe, 1.0 for the Lightning build).

keep_size.description: Resize the result back to the input size (the model renders at about 1 MP).

seed.description: Fixed seed for a reproducible result (default: random).
